subject: Re: Preparation review reminder
text: I realized after looking again that I read the calendar entry incorrectly last week. It said preparation review, not final submission, and I had arranged my team's notes on that assumption. The reminder I sent to the group may have created unnecessary confusion, so I wanted to clarify here. If Tuesday at three still suits you, I would prefer to keep it for the preparation review, but I can also move the slot if you have already reserved time for the final materials. Either way, I appreciate your patience with the mix-up and will be more careful when I check the shared schedule before sending anything.
